basics.description:
[ANY.RUN’s Interactive Sandbox](https://any.run/features/?utm_source=ms-defender-marketplace-sb&utm_medium=ms-defender-marketplace-sb&utm_campaign=ms-defender-marketplace-sb&utm_content=linktosandboxlanding) integrates seamlessly with Microsoft Defender for Endpoint (MDE) to streamline alert triage, accelerate threat investigation, and eliminate manual analysis overhead for SOC teams and incident responders. It automates suspicious file and URL analysis and brings detailed behavioral context directly into Microsoft Defender for Endpoint.

**Connector’s functionality**

The connector triggers automatically upon the registration of a new alert in MDE, extracting and analyzing entities such as URLs or files associated with the alert.

* Alert comments include the ANY.RUN verdict, threat score, a link to the detailed analysis report, and any IOCs discovered during the sandbox detonation
* Extracted IOCs are also imported into Microsoft Defender for Endpoint as indicators for enhanced detection and response

**Key SOC benefits**

The connector empowers SOC teams with deeper insights into potential threats, accelerating triage, reducing false positives, and enabling proactive hunting:

* Accelerate Alert Triage & Response: Automatically submit suspicious files and URLs extracted from MDE alerts directly to ANY.RUN for real-time detonation.
* Real-Time Behavioral Context: Receive immediate verdicts, extracted IOCs, and direct links to live interactive analysis sessions within your Microsoft Defender workflow.
* Automated SOC Playbooks: Configure flexible automated submission rules based on alert properties to handle high-volume threats with minimal manual intervention.
* Seamless Threat Intelligence Integration: Add newly discovered IOCs to Microsoft Defender for Endpoint as custom indicators for proactive enterprise-wide defense.

basics.name: instanceName
basics.label: Instance name
basics.toolTip: Used in the names of all resources of this deployment. Keep the suggested random value to create a new instance, or enter the name of an existing instance to update it. 1-12 lowercase letters and digits.

options.text: Resource names use this instance, for example ANYRUN-Sandbox-MDE-<instance>-LA and ANYRUN-Sandbox-MDE-<instance>-<hash>-FA. The suggested random name creates a new instance. To update an existing instance, enter its name (see the Instance tag on its resources).
Requires permission to create role assignments on the resource group: Owner, User Access Administrator or Role Based Access Control Administrator.

The selected region has not been confirmed as supporting Azure Functions Flex Consumption. Wait for the region list to load. If this message persists, check Microsoft.Web access or choose another region.

Before you continue: create an app registration in Microsoft Entra ID and grant it the WindowsDefenderATP application permissions Alert.ReadWrite.All, Machine.LiveResponse, Machine.ReadWrite.All, Ti.ReadWrite and Library.Manage with admin consent, then create a client secret. Use a dedicated app registration for this connector. Click here for step-by-step instructions.

In the Microsoft Defender portal enable Settings > Endpoints > Advanced features: Live Response, Live Response for Servers and Live Response unsigned script execution. The connector uses Live Response to collect evidence files from devices.
